limitations: The original npm runner supervisor was interrupted; its command exit code remains unknown and its report is preserved. An uninterrupted npm run test:prince success is not claimed.
The first standalone attempt failed when the 270-second no-checkpoint watchdog closed its browser during the Earth garden interaction. Its failed reports remain intact.

The second standalone attempt timed out during its initial 180-second long walk after 66 rendered frames and x=9.39531421661377, before any check or encounter completed. The successful player result belongs to a separate third attempt at lower DPR.

Chromium uses SwiftShader and UI-selected low quality: DPR 0.5 for the passed desktop/mobile application phase and DPR 0.25 for the passed standalone retry. These are not hardware GPU frame-rate results.
Mobile validation uses a 390 by 844 mobile layout and pointer dragging on the visible joystick, not a real device or native multi-touch.
Browser edge checks use labeled near-edge setup followed by real input; continuous spawn-to-boundary traversal is covered by real-GLB automated tests.
No Windows Edge, hardware mobile GPU, long-duration stress test or full Blender rebuild was performed.
The original supervisor's in-memory server log could not be recovered after interruption.
